title: Review Envelope (mode:agent)
description: Single JSON object the reviewing skill returns in mode:agent. Per-lane outputs (lane-findings.schema.json) are merged, deduplicated, and confidence-gated into this envelope.

schema_version.description: Contract version; consumers reject unknown versions rather than guessing

status.description: failed only for pipeline errors (bad arguments, unreadable scope); an empty findings list is still ok

reason.description: One-line failure reason. Required when status=failed.

verdict.description: clean = no P0-P2 actionable findings; actionable = fixable findings present; blocked = P0/P1 findings the caller must resolve before advancing

excluded.description: Paths excluded from review (e.g. untracked files)

findings.description: Merged, deduplicated, confidence-gated findings. Each item follows lane-findings.schema.json's finding shape (merge tier), plus the fields below.

lanes.description: Lanes that reported this finding (>1 after dedup merge; cross-lane agreement promotes confidence one anchor step)

validated.description: Result of the independent validator pass; null when the validator did not run (budget cap or degraded infra)

rollup.description: 3-tier human-facing rollup for callers not wired for P0-P3: P0→critical, P1→important, P2+P3→minor

artifact_dir.description: Directory holding full detail-tier artifacts (why_it_matters, evidence) for each finding
